template.colour: RGB hex from tokens.json (official tokens); print values (CMYK) are in tokens.json

reference_note: Faithful vector reproduction of the source page (source colours as a viewer shows them, original copy including typos). Hidden leftovers are listed under omitted.
notes: Source has no bleed box (art overshoots the page by 3 to 20 mm); templates are built with 3 mm bleed. Front: the beeldmerk at 1.508x (54.3 x 65.5 mm) runs 20.7 mm off the left, 10.0 mm off the top and 0.5 mm off the bottom; the part beyond the 3 mm bleed lies outside the template viewBox. Back: the source background overshoots the trim only 0.2 mm at the bottom and 3.3 mm at the top; the template runs the navy into 3 mm all round. The watermark is 5 percent (the Phase 1 document said 10 percent). The back lockup is the reverse lockup (white bubble, aqua dot) at 0.511x of the A6 lockup, centred on the card; the tagline is live text so it can be a variable. Card number and plate fields are blank in print (input fields only).
